Coquitlam condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Coquitlam was $640,100 in September 2026 (-7.3% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Coquitlam: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $640,100 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.3%; over three months it fell 2.1%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 12.3%; over 5 years it rose 1.7%; over 10 years it rose 59.8%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy condos in Coquitlam
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Coquitlam was $640,100 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 7.3%. Over three months it fell 2.1%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when condos come up in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
